scope: Level-13 Kira, equal item-count cores, fixed active Knell stack snapshots in production combatDamage
limits: Stacks are held fixed throughout each snapshot; these are not stack acquisition/expiry simulations.
Stolen defenses, Peal and source interactions are omitted. Existing item, hit-order and current-health approximations remain.
Cores can have different costs. Selection and historical win evidence do not validate build superiority.
Unsupported reviewed replay items are skipped. Supported cores still retain their recorded modeling omissions.

limitations: Deathstalker / Virulent Strikes + Onslaught: Client triggers on hero on-hit events with a next-engine-tick gate. Production credits prior basic-hit stacks only, using uniform attack spacing and shared refresh. Ability/proc benefits, Mercy triggers, frame batching and cross-target state remain unmodeled. Three seconds is expiry, not a time-to-full ramp.

Viper / Corrode + Diligence: Diligence grants 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage only against Eroded targets (6 stacks). The simulator lacks target stack state; do not amplify all basic damage unconditionally.
Manta-Scythe / Divide & Conquer: Insatiable Harvest is a PvE 1.5x-to-minions + per-kill PP farming stack.
